title: OPTIMIZING DECODING PATHS IN MASKED DIFFUSION MODELS BY QUANTIFYING UNCERTAINTY
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical optimization of decoding paths in Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) through uncertainty quantification. Its evaluations are based on mathematical reasoning, planning, and code generation benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, MATH500, HumanEval). It does not engage with religion, theology, faith, or moral/ethical benchmarking.
